facts.fact: The World Bank engagement note states that Guinea-Bissau did not yet possess a national digital strategy, only a digital economy roadmap developed with UNDP, and recommends developing a national vision and strategy for digital transformation within the first year or two; the note gives only 2023 as its date and is dated here by its published date.

systems.owner: World Bank, US$60 million for Guinea-Bissau
